AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Nitrogen gas only

3. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 50 °C

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Poultry Rearing in a Fold? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Poultry Rearing in a Fold.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Poultry Rearing in a Fold.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Poultry Rearing in a Fold.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Poultry Rearing in a Fold.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil Conservation Measures? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Soil Conservation Measures.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil Conservation Measures.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil Conservation Measures.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil Conservation Measures.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning the Kitchen? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning the Kitchen.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning the Kitchen.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning the Kitchen.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning the Kitchen.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving animal products? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving animal products.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving animal products.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving animal products.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving animal products.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Kitchen and Backyard Gardening? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.

11. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

12. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

13. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Producers
   D. Primary consumers only

14. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Burning crop residue every week

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing.

   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning the Kitchen 9 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Sewing Skills: Constructing.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Harvesting and Storage? (1 mark)

   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Harvesting and Storage.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Harvesting and Storage.
